items.title: Egypt: Egypt, CIA Chief Affirm Support for Somalia's Sovereignty
items.description: [Radio Dalsan] Cairo -- Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi met with CIA Director John Ratcliffe in Cairo on Sunday, September 20, 2026, where both leaders reaffirmed support for Somalia's security and stability. The meeting, also attended by Egyptian General Intelligence Director Hassan Rashad, focused on regional developments including the situations in Somalia, Sudan, Gaza, and the Horn of Africa .
items.titleIt: Egypt: Egypt, CIA Chief Affirm Support for Somalia's Sovereignty

items.title: Greece-Egypt military exercise draws tourists’ attention in Crete
items.description: Vacationers on the Greek island of Crete — taking a morning dip or seeking shade on wooden sunbeds — watched a major military exercise unfold on a beachfront Friday, just 50 meters (yards) away.
items.titleIt: Greece-Egypt military exercise draws tourists’ attention in Crete

items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.
items.titleIt: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.
items.titleIt: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran

items.title: Gulf troop deployments to be adjusted says Chigi meet
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 21 SET - A risk assessment regarding the deployment of Italian military personnel in certain Gulf areas was conducted during a high-level meeting at Palazzo Chigi today, pointing to a need to adjust the contingents involved, well-informed sources said. items.title: Ambassador Del Monaco Meets with the Director of the Kenya Space Agency
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 21 SET - The Italian Ambassador to Nairobi, Vincenzo Del Monaco, met with the Director General of the Kenya Space Agency, Major General Hillary Kipkosgey, and visited the KSA’s Regional Earth Observation Center in Nairobi, where they discussed opportunities to further strengthen cooperation between Italy and Kenya in the space sector, with particular reference to Earth observation, satellite data, and the development of new skills and applications. Collaboration between Italy and Kenya in the space sector continues to open new avenues for research, innovation, and capacity build
items.titleIt: Ambassador Del Monaco Meets with the Director of the Kenya Space Agency

items.title: Africa: AU, UN Reinforce Joint Commitments On Peace, Economy and Resource Equity
items.description: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- The Chairperson of the African Union Commission, Mahmoud Ali Youssouf, and United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres have co-chaired a high-level AU-UN meeting on the margins of the 81st United Nations General Assembly to deepen strategic cooperation, strengthen peace and security frameworks, and advance global financial reforms in support of Africa.
items.titleIt: Africa: AU, UN Reinforce Joint Commitments On Peace, Economy and Resource Equity

items.title: Kenya: Museveni Says Kenyan Media Misrepresented His Fuel Remarks, Thanks Ruto for Supporting Uganda Fuel Deal
items.description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni has clarified remarks that triggered a fresh debate over petroleum imports between Kenya and Uganda, saying sections of the Kenyan media misrepresented what he said about the use of middlemen in fuel procurement.
items.titleIt: Kenya: Museveni Says Kenyan Media Misrepresented His Fuel Remarks, Thanks Ruto for Supporting Uganda Fuel Deal

items.title: Kenya: Health workers increasingly concerned in wake of USAID cuts
items.description: In Kenya, the impact of USAID cuts is being increasingly felt. At least 24 deaths of HIV-positive sex workers in Kenya have been reported, who, like Beatrice, in good health until aid was slashed by the United States early last year, health workers say.
items.titleIt: Kenya: Health workers increasingly concerned in wake of USAID cuts

items.title: Sudan: Blood On Foreign Powers' Hands
items.description: [IPS] London -- Sudan's civil war grinds on. It's close to three and a half years since the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) militia began their battle for supremacy, and the two forces and their allies continue to slaughter civilians with impunity. As a recent UN report makes clear, the killing is enabled by numerous foreign powers that continue to supply weapons, personnel and logistical support. items.title: Egypt: Egypt Says It Backs South Sudan's Fula Dam After Review, Renews Objections to Ethiopia's GERD
items.description: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Egypt has agreed to South Sudan's planned Grand Fula Dam after reviewing technical studies on the project, Egyptian Minister of Water Resources and Irrigation Hani Sewilam said, as Cairo simultaneously reiterated its objections to Ethiopia's unilateral operation of the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD).

items.title: Uganda: Nearly 1,000 Cattle Die in Month As Drought Ravages Kasese
items.description: [Nile Post] Nearly 1,000 cattle have died in Nyakatonzi Sub-county, Kasese District, in the past month as prolonged drought leaves livestock farmers without adequate pasture and water.
